intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Lynnwood for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 2 of them free. New in this update: Photos with Santa at Alderwood Mall (from November 26), Cookies with Santa at Heritage Park (November 29) and Christmas in Lynnwood at the Community Life Center (December 4). We check every date on the host’s own website or an official city calendar, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Washington Christmas events for kids guide.

Planning a bigger day out? Lynnwood families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Seattle, which covers Seattle Center Winterfest, WildLanterns, the North Pole Limited Santa train and more.

Planning Christmas Eve in Lynnwood? See Christmas Eve service times in Lynnwood.

What Rally found in Lynnwood

  • 7 Christmas events for kids in Lynnwood
  • 2 free to attend
  • Meet Santa: Photos with Santa at Alderwood Mall (from November 26), Cookies with Santa at Heritage Park (November 29) and Christmas on the Farm at Vaughn's Farm (from December 5)
  • Also on the list: 1 show and 2 light displays
  • New events in this update run November 26 to December 24
  • Every date checked on the host’s own site or an official city calendar on Nov 26
